alternatives: Build a new agriculture business application architecture versus architecture of the existing workflow toolkit; selected toolkit scope per approved Stage 02.
Introduce an application service/database/frontend versus retain local Python scripts and file-based contracts; user confirmed the current toolkit approach and no frontend/backend.
